manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 169
text:
Page 001
001-1. junitiusNyansjutiujtius RP CL/RD TS TL
001-2. Paragon Scans
001-3. discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx

Page 002
002-1. IDON'T NEED I DON'T NEED THE AC ANYMORE, YOU CAN HAVE DUCANHAY YOUR BED BACK.
002-2. THE PLAN TO GET MY KA YUAN ERA WIFE TO OPEN UP HAS NOT YET SUCCEEDED, I'LL HAVE TO TRY HARDER NEXT TIME.

Page 003
003-1. I-I'M REALLY NOT AFRAID OF THE HEAT!
003-2. SHOULD WE SLEEP HERE TOGETHER THEN?
003-3. IKNEWIT~
003-4. IN ANY CASE, YOU'RE ONLY ALLOWED TO SLEEP IN THE OTHER ROOM, I WON'T BUDGE ON THIS.
003-5. BY THE WAY, DIDN'T YOU SAY THAT WE SHOULD SAVE ON ELECT- RICITY?
003-6. AND.THAT WE CAN'T WASTE ELECTRICITY?
003-7. EVEN THOUGH WE'RE CLDDLING AND KISSING ALL DAY LONG,
003-8. WE'RE STILL...
003-9. THE HELL!?

Page 004
004-1. ALRIGHT! GOOD NIGHT!
004-2. .RETURN THE BLANKET TO ME.

Page 005
005-1. ...HERE.
005-2. I'LL KICK YOU OFF THE BED IF YOU DARE TO TOLCH ME.
005-3. I'LL THEN MOVE BACK TO THE STORAGE ROOM. THIS IS YOURORIGINAL ROOMAFTERALL~
005-4. NOTHE STORAGE ROOMISACTLALLY MY ROOM,I'MJLST HERE TO ENJOY THE AC,AND I DON'T HAVE ANY OTHER INTENTIONS.
005-5. ISWEAR~

Page 006
006-1. DO YOU THINK THAT I'LL BELIEVE YOUR NONSENSE?
006-2. WE UNKNOWINGLY ENDED UP SLEEPING ONTHESAMEBED,IWAS TRICKED SOMEHOW!
006-3. I KNEWIT YOU WERE UP TO NO GOOD EVER SINCE WE SWITCHED ROOMS AT THE BEGINNING.
006-4. THIS WAS ALL A RUSE! IF HE DIDN'T USE A NONSENSICALEXCUSETO GET USTOSWITCHROOMS, I WOULDVE KICKED HIMOUT IF HE TRIED TO LINGER ON THE STOR- AGEROOMBED,ANDIWOULD HAVENEVERAGREEDTO MOVE IN WITH HIM. 我们应该商量一下 你搬进我屋这回事
006-5. NOW THAT WEVE SWITCHEDOUR ROOMS, WHEN HE TRIES TO MOVE IN WITH THAT THICK SKIN OF HIS, I CANT EVEN MOVE BACK TO THE STORAGE ROOM, OR HELL BE ANANNOYANCE.
006-6. THE MORE I THINK ABOUT IT, THE ANGRIER I GET! I HAVE TO THINK OF A WAYTOGIVE HIM A GOOD BEATING!

Page 007
007-1. SECOND MISS, I'VE BROUGHT MY BENEFACTORTO THE BED WITH ME. IPROMISEDTO KEEPMY CONSCIENCE CLEAR~
007-2. WE'RE NOT EVEN DOING ANY- THINGAND WE HAVE NOTHING TO HIDE. WE ARE JUST A LITTLE CLOSERNOW,AND WE'RE NOT EVEN TOUCHING...
007-3. AS A COUPLE, WE'RE AS PURE'AS WHITE SHEETS, OKAY?
007-4. ATTHE BEGINNING..AT THE START... WE..
007-5. YOU DON'T HAVE TO SAY ANYMORE, I'M JUST PURELY HUDDLING OVER HERE, JUST AS ISHOULD,
007-6. YOU CAN MOVE OVER A LITTLE, OR YOULL ACCIDENTALLY FALL OFF THE BED IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT~
007-7. I DON'T WANT TO! EVEN THOUGH WE'RE JUST PURELY SLEEPINGTOGETHER NOW, YOU'LL SURELY TAKE ADVANTAGE OF IT IN THE COMING DAYS AND WANT TO TOUCH ME SOONER OR LATER!

Page 008
008-1. YOU'VE SAD IT YOURSELF,IT'LL HAPPEN SOONER OR LATER, SO WHY DOES IT MATTER IFIT HAP- PENS SOONER.
008-2. STRETCH YOUR HAND OUT.
008-3. HERE YOuGO-

Page 009
009-1. WE'RE GONNA TOUCH SOONER OR LATER, SO HERE'S A PRE-EMPTIVE STRIKE!
009-2. SINCE YOUVE ALREADY TOUCHED ME,DOES THAT MEAN I CAN TOUCH YOUNOW?
009-3. I'LL KICK TLIVICV YOU OFF IF YOUDO.
009-4. I SUFFERED FOR NOTHING!

Page 010
010-1. .WHY AREN'T YOU ASLEEP YET? THAT'S THE SIXTH TIME YOUVE FLIPPED OVER~
010-2. I CAN'T FALL ASLEEP.
010-3. THE SMELL, SINCE WE'VE BOTH USED THE SAME SHAMPOO TO WASH OUR HAIR...
010-4. CANYOU STRETCH YOUR HAND OVER HERE?
010-5. WHAT FOR?
010-6. TOUCHING YOUR HANDS IS NOT A BIG DEAL,IS IT?

Page 011
011-1. ..YOU'RE ONLY ALLOWEDTO TOUCH MY HAND.
011-2. HER HAND IS REALLYSOFT AND IT SMELLS GREAT...
011-3. WHY DOES IT SMELL LIKE MY HAND LOTION?! DID YOU SECRET- LY USE IT?

Page 012
012-1. I DIDN'T!
012-2. THAT SMELL IS UNMISTAKABLE! DID YOU NOT BLY YOUR HAND CREAM?
012-3. ..I DID AND I'M USING .
012-4. YOU'RE NOT BEING HONEST-
012-5. I'M USING MY HAND CREAM! I'M TIRED!GOOD NIGHT!
012-6. DOES THIS GUY HAVE A DOG'S SENSE OF SMELL?
012-7. HMPH,I'LL TALK TO YOU ABOUTTHIS TOMORROW.

Page 013
013-1. GETTING YOUR WISH GRANTED FEELS GREAT, EVEN IF WE'RE NOT HAVING ANYPHYSICALCONTACT, WATCHING HER SLEEP FROM OVER HERE MAKES ME FEEL COMFY AS WELL.
013-2. WARRIORESS?
013-3. Good night.
